method.buildingDimensions: Building.width × depth are parcel-envelope dimensions. The renderer sets structures back and uses kind/profile-specific massing.
method.interpretation: Coverage and FAR are nominal parcel-envelope proxies, not actual rendered building footprint or usable floor area.
method.occupancy: Building.occupancy counts residents for homes and apartments. Commercial occupancy is not modeled; open commercial buildings are classified as commercial regardless of this field.
method.engineVacancyBehavior: Engine demand and renewal logic currently treats any open occupancy-zero building as vacant, including commercial buildings. This report does not apply that heuristic to commercial status.

denominator: gross area of world.bounds, including water and protected land
